versions.subject: fix: FPs (testing, and Windows 2022 test system)
fix: FPs from new evtx-baseline
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetObject|contains:
        - 'Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Accessibility\ATs'
        - 'Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Accessibility\Configuration'
filter:
    Image: 'C:\Windows\system32\atbroker.exe'
    TargetObject|contains: '\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Accessibility\Configuration'
    Details: '(Empty)'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: TargetObject IN ("*Software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Accessibility\\ATs*", "*Software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Accessibility\\Configuration*") NOT (Image="C:\\Windows\\system32\\atbroker.exe" TargetObject="*\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Accessibility\\Configuration*" Details="(Empty)")
